effective_slots.final-cta-body: Explore the research lines, the questions that guide them and the methods proposed for their development.
effective_slots.hero-lead: Applied research on how autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems can be designed, integrated and evaluated in real organisational environments while remaining reliable, traceable and governable.
effective_slots.research-lines-intro: The research agenda focuses on autonomous AI agents, human–AI collaboration, digital transformation in SMEs and AI-mediated information discovery.
effective_slots.selected-outputs-intro: Research outputs will be listed here as publications, projects, software or datasets become available and are verified.
